proof_body:
by
  intro p n hp hn
  have hcard := GaloisField.card p n hn
  have hne : p ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hp.out.ne_zero
  refine ⟨hcard, ?_⟩
  intro K _ hK
  haveI : Finite K := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hK]; exact hne)
  haveI : Finite (GaloisField p n) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hcard]; exact hne)
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite K
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite (GaloisField p n)
  exact ⟨FiniteField.ringEquivOfCardEq (by rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, hK, hcard])⟩
target_source: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], n ≠ 0 → Nat.card (GaloisField p n) = p ^ n ∧ ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K], Nat.card K = p ^ n → Nonempty (K ≃+* GaloisField p n)
